title: Concept: Server-side fetch of assembled URL (kotlin) — review required
description: In kotlin, URL(base + p) fetches a URL composed from runtime input, so a caller can redirect the request to internal hosts or cloud metadata. The remedy is a fixed destination or an allowlist (a host allowlist).
applicability: kotlin server code; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Internal access via metadata and intranet; HIGH severity.
